summary.bn: এক তারে তাপমাত্রা আর আর্দ্রতা পাঠায়।
summary.en: Sends temperature and humidity on one wire.

simplified: The sensor answers with the temperature and humidity set on its sliders, at once: it has no warm-up and no slow response to a change.
Readings are whole degrees and whole percent, as the sensor gives them, with no error or drift.
The module is drawn and modelled with its pull-up resistor on the data line, as the three-pin module has.
The voltage shown on the data line does not move while the sensor is sending.
